use: a sports rule, explained in space
request: Explain the offside rule in soccer in 20 seconds, with an example.
intent: A new soccer fan wants to understand calls during a match.
goal: The viewer can judge a simple offside call from the positions at the moment of the pass.
arc: A pitch with players, the moment of the pass frozen, the line of the second-last defender, an example to judge, the call.

events.look: the pitch with the attackers, defenders and goal

events.text: At the moment your teammate passes, look at the defenders between you and the goal.
events.knows: It is judged at the moment of the pass.
events.look: the moment of the pass, and the defenders

events.text: You need at least two of them level with you or closer to their goal. Usually that's the keeper plus one.
events.knows: Two defenders level or closer, usually the keeper plus one.
events.look: the line of the second defender
the striker and the defenders' positions at the pass

holds.does: the positions stay frozen at the pass, with no call shown

events.text: Only the keeper is closer. Offside.
events.look: the striker past the last outfield defender, and the call

measure.derived: Derived once from the request, intent and audience; thresholds not named here take the defaults in bench/lib/settings.ts. Read sizes scale with how wide the frame looks: a classroom or meeting screen from the back looks narrower than a phone at arm's length, a laptop at a desk wider. A hold listed as still is one the plan asks to wait without motion.

quiz.a: At the moment the teammate passes the ball.

quiz.q: How many defenders must be level with you or closer to their goal?
quiz.a: At least two (usually the keeper plus one).

quiz.q: Was the striker in the example offside?
quiz.a: Yes: only the keeper was closer to the goal.

quiz.q: In the example, where was the last outfield defender compared with the striker?
quiz.a: Farther from the goal than the striker (the striker was past him).

quiz.q: During the pause, was the call shown?
During the pause, were the positions moving or frozen?
quiz.a: Frozen at the moment of the pass.

quiz.q: Which defender's line was picked out?
